notes: VAT 12% on full price, bars and jewellery; no retail exemption (relief only for SSM/trader sales to BSP, RA 11256). Jewellery also has 20% excise (NIRC Sec.150). Duty 10% is MFN for gold jewellery per Tariff Finder reports; bullion duty unverified, hence low. Making 6-10% souk (branded 15-25%). Cebuana minted gift bars not coded as generic premium. 21K most traded; 18K local fine standard.
